name: Marvel Cinematic Universe
description: The interconnected film universe established by Marvel Studios beginning with Iron Man (2008), centered on the Avengers and the Sacred Timeline.

name: Fox X-Men Universe
description: The cinematic continuity produced by 20th Century Fox featuring the mutant struggle, the X-Men, Wolverine, and Deadpool.

name: Sam Raimi Spider-Man Trilogy
description: The foundational Columbia Pictures Spider-Man trilogy directed by Sam Raimi starring Tobey Maguire, later intersecting the multiverse in No Way Home.

name: The Amazing Spider-Man Series
description: The Sony Pictures film series directed by Marc Webb starring Andrew Garfield, following Peter Parker's battles against Oscorp's creations.

name: Spider-Verse Animated
description: Sony Pictures Animation's critically acclaimed franchise centering on Miles Morales and the cross-dimensional Spider-Society.

name: Sony's Spider-Man Universe
description: Sony's live-action cinematic universe focusing on anti-heroes and adversaries including Venom and Eddie Brock.

name: Fantastic Four (2005 / 2007)
description: The 20th Century Fox film duology directed by Tim Story featuring the first live-action modern cinematic Marvel superhero family.

name: Earth-838 Alternate Reality
description: The parallel universe visited in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness, governed by the Illuminati.

name: Blade Trilogy
description: The groundbreaking New Line Cinema vampire-hunter trilogy starring Wesley Snipes as the Daywalker.

name: Earth-828 (Fantastic Four: First Steps)
description: A retro-futuristic 1960s alternate reality protected by the Fantastic Four, distinct from Earth-616.

name: Daredevil & Elektra (2003 / 2005)
description: The shared 20th Century Fox and New Regency theatrical continuity of Daredevil (2003) and Elektra (2005).

name: Ghost Rider Films (2007 / 2012)
description: Columbia Pictures' Ghost Rider duology starring Nicolas Cage as Johnny Blaze, where Spirit of Vengeance (2012) acts as a soft-rebooted continuation.

name: The Punisher (2004)
description: Lionsgate's 2004 theatrical adaptation starring Thomas Jane as Frank Castle, independent of other Punisher films.

name: Punisher: War Zone (2008)
description: Lionsgate's 2008 standalone reboot starring Ray Stevenson as Frank Castle, separate from the 2004 film.

name: The Punisher (1989)
description: New World Pictures' 1989 theatrical adaptation starring Dolph Lundgren as Frank Castle.
